crossRefs.note: How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when…
Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither…
Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?
Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.
Deliver me, Yahweh, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why…
Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”
Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.
